title: ED freezes Rs 526 crore bank deposits in PMLA case against Gameskraft
summary: In a major crackdown, the Enforcement Directorate has immobilised assets worth over Rs 526 crore from the online gaming platform Gameskraft, including cash and jewellery. Raids were executed across Delhi-NCR and Bengaluru, leading to the arrest of three key founders. The agency claims that illegal bots were employed to deceive users, resulting in extensive financial damages and hardship.
hook: ED ne Gameskraft ke Rs 526 crore freeze kiye hain.
pivot: Ye kaise hua, aao samjhte hain.
tech_angle: 1. The Enforcement Directorate claims Gameskraft used illegal bots to manipulate user interactions, essentially creating a false sense of winning. 2. These bots would simulate real players, skewing the game's fairness and leading to financial losses for genuine users. 3. Significant financial transactions were tracked through behavioral analytics, revealing patterns that indicated fraudulent activity. 4. The PMLA (Prevention of Money Laundering Act) allows ED to freeze assets if they suspect financial misappropriation or fraud, which in this case totals over Rs 526 crore. 5. Raids across major cities like Delhi and Bengaluru were executed, targeting the founders and their operational infrastructure, leading to three arrests.

title: US judge considers Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement of authors' lawsuit
summary: A federal judge is seeking more details on Anthropic's $1.5 billion AI settlement with authors, delaying final approval. The case, the largest US copyright settlement, involves claims of unauthorized book use for AI training. Objections cite insufficient payouts and attorney fees, while some authors opt out.
hook: Anthropic ka $1.5 billion ka copyright settlement abhi pending hai.
pivot: Ye kyun delay ho raha hai, aaja samjhte hain.
tech_angle:
1. Anthropic ka settlement sabse bada copyright case hai US mein, jisme $1.5 billion ki rakam hai.
2. Authors ka kehna hai ki unhe unauthorized book use ke liye sahi compensation nahi mila.
3. Kuch authors ne is settlement se opt-out kiya hai, jo is case ko aur complex banata hai.
4. Judge ko settlement ke terms aur attorney fees par bhi objections mile hain, jo approval ko slow kar rahe hain.
5. Ye case AI training data ke liye copyright laws ka future bhi redefine kar sakta hai.

title: Maharashtra Transport Minister seeks shutdown of Ola, Uber, Rapido ‘bike taxi’ services
summary:
In his letter to the ADG of Police, Maharashtra Cyber, the transport minister alleged that the platforms have been operating passenger transport services without govt approval or compliance to regulations.

The post Maharashtra Transport Minister seeks shutdown of Ola, Uber, Rapido ‘bike taxi’ services appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
hook: Maharashtra ne Ola, Uber, Rapido bike taxi services band karne ko bola.
pivot: Ye kaise hoga, chalo samjhte hain iske peeche ka reason.
tech_angle: 1. Regulatory compliance: Maharashtra transport rules mandate that all passenger transport services must seek government approval. 2. License verification: Companies like Ola and Uber typically require a commercial license for operating taxi services, which is currently under scrutiny. 3. Safety standards: There are specific safety and insurance requirements that these bike taxi services need to fulfill to operate legally. 4. Data sharing: These platforms may be required to share user and trip data with the government for monitoring. 5. Impact on market: If these services shut down, it could affect around 10 lakh users in Mumbai alone, leading to increased demand for traditional taxis.

title: Inside foreign universities’ desperate attempts to woo indifferent Indians
summary: The post Inside foreign universities’ desperate attempts to woo indifferent Indians appeared first on The Ken.
hook: Foreign universities ka Indian students ko attract karne ka budget 100 crore hai.
pivot: Lekin ye kyu ho raha hai, aaja samjhte hain.
tech_angle: 1. Foreign universities ne India me 100 crore ka budget allocate kiya hai apne outreach programs ke liye. 2. Indian students ki demand increase hone se, in universities ko apne admission numbers badhane ki zarurat hai. 3. Average tuition fees abroad 20 lakh se lekar 50 lakh tak hoti hai, jo unka revenue badha sakta hai. 4. USA, UK aur Canada jaise countries me Indian students ki population 3 lakh se zyada hai, jo ek potential market hai. 5. Agar ek university apne admission process ko streamline kare, toh wo 30% zyada applications attract kar sakti hai.

title: Louis Rossmann taunts Bambu Lab by hosting banned 3D Printer firmware fork, dares $1 billion company to sue him — more creators pledge support and boycotts, Snapmaker donates equipment to embattled developer
hook: Louis Rossmann ne banned 3D printer firmware ko host kiya hai.
pivot: Ye controversy kaise badi opportunity ban sakti hai, suno.
tech_angle: 1. Bambu Lab ki valuation $1 billion hai, par Louis ka firmware free hai. 2. 3D printing market India mein 2023 tak 1,500 crore INR tak pahunchne ki umeed hai. 3. Snapmaker ne support karke potential customers ko attract kiya hai, jo Bambu Lab se naraaz hain. 4. Open-source firmware ka use karne wale creators ki community badi ho rahi hai, jo monetization ke naye raaste khol sakti hai. 5. Is controversy se naye startups 3D printing solutions develop kar sakte hain, jisse unhe market share mil sakta hai.

title: Over 12 lakh chemists to shut shops on May 20 over fake AI prescriptions
summary:
Why are chemists across India planning a nationwide shutdown on May 20? The battle over online medicine sales is reaching a breaking point.

The post Over 12 lakh chemists to shut shops on May 20 over fake AI prescriptions appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
hook: 12 lakh chemists 20 May ko dukan bandh karne wale hain.
pivot: Ye kis wajah se ho raha hai, aaja samjhte hain.
tech_angle: 1. AI-generated prescriptions are being used for ordering medicines online, creating authenticity issues. 2. Chemists are concerned about the lack of regulation on AI prescriptions, leading to potential misuse. 3. There's a need for a verification mechanism to validate prescriptions before they are filled. 4. The current regulatory framework does not sufficiently address the rise of online pharmacies. 5. This strike is aimed at pushing for stricter guidelines to safeguard chemists' interests.

title: The EU is going after TikTok and Meta over addictive algorithms and child safety failures
hook: EU ne TikTok aur Meta ko child safety ke liye target kiya hai.
pivot: Ye algorithms kaise addictive hote hain, aaja samjhte hain.
tech_angle: 1. Recommendation Systems: TikTok aur Meta dono machine learning algorithms use karte hain jo user engagement ko maximize karte hain, jisme user behavior ko analyze kiya jata hai. 2. A/B Testing: In platforms par A/B testing hota hai, jisse pata chalta hai kaunsa content zyada addictive hai. 3. User Data Tracking: Ye platforms user ke data ko track karte hain, jaise watch time aur interaction rate, takki personalized content deliver kiya ja sake. 4. Feedback Loops: Algorithms ko aise design kiya gaya hai ki wo feedback loops create karte hain, jisse users ko zyada time spend karne par majboor kiya jata hai. 5. Child Safety Violations: EU ke regulations ke tahat, in companies ko child safety measures implement karne honge, warna hefty fines deni pad sakti hai, jo billions INR tak ja sakti hai.

hook: Claude aur dusre LLMs coding mein galtiyan karte hain.
pivot: Ye issues kyun hote hain, chalo samjhte hain thoda detail mein.
tech_angle: 1. Data Quality: Claude jise LLMs training data se seekhte hain, agar data biased ya incomplete hai, toh output bhi galat hoga. 2. Prompt Sensitivity: LLMs ka response prompt ki wording pe depend karta hai. Agar prompt clear nahi hai, toh result bhi ambiguous hoga. 3. Model Limitations: Claude jaise models ko specific tasks ke liye optimize nahi kiya gaya, jo complex coding problems ko solve karne mein dikkat daal sakta hai. 4. Context Handling: LLMs context ko samajhne mein kabhi kabhi fail ho jaate hain, jo ki programming tasks mein errors la sakta hai. 5. Continuous Learning: Claude aur dusre models ko real-time feedback aur updates ki zarurat hoti hai, warna unka performance stagnant ho jata hai.
